description: Trait de côte HISTOLITT® is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Région Provence-Alpes-Côte-d'Azur. The HISTOLITT® coastline is composed of elements resulting from the digitization of nautical charts at scales greater than 1/25000. In some port areas, maps at scales of 1/5000 have been used, based on the BDTOPO® product and elements captured in 2D against a background BDORTHO® image. Coverage: Région Provence-Alpes-Côte-d'Azur. The portal shows the English title as "HISTOLITT® Coastline" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Région Provence-Alpes-Côte-d'Azur. Its keywords include monlittoral, trait-de-cote, littoral, mer. The listing shows 4 download or service links in PDF, OGC:WFS, JPEG. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
